arguments.message:
When an import finishes, any rows that didn’t make it are usually being skipped by a per‑row validation that isn’t shown on the main screen (e.g., a missing required field, a malformed email address, or a duplicate). You can see exactly which rows were rejected by opening **Settings → Data → Import history**, selecting the run, and reviewing the per‑row results – each failed row will have a reason listed.

Fix the issues on the flagged rows and then re‑run the import for just those rows (instead of the whole file) to avoid re‑processing the rows that already succeeded. This should bring the missing replies back into the thread.
